tests.name: with_string_t_basic
tests.intent: Verify that basic_json::with_string_t correctly produces a json type with a custom string type.

tests.name: with_object_t_basic
tests.intent: Verify that basic_json::with_object_t correctly sets a custom object map type.

tests.name: with_array_t_basic
tests.intent: Verify that basic_json::with_array_t correctly sets a custom array sequence type.

tests.name: with_boolean_t_basic
tests.intent: Verify that basic_json::with_boolean_t configures a custom boolean type.

tests.name: with_integers_t_basic
tests.intent: Verify that basic_json::with_integers_t configures both signed and unsigned integer types simultaneously.

tests.name: with_float_t_basic
tests.intent: Verify that basic_json::with_float_t sets a custom floating point type.

tests.name: with_allocator_t_basic
tests.intent: Verify that basic_json::with_allocator_t assigns a custom allocator template.

tests.name: with_json_serializer_t_basic
tests.intent: Verify that basic_json::with_json_serializer_t sets a custom serializer template.

tests.name: with_binary_t_basic
tests.intent: Verify that basic_json::with_binary_t sets a custom binary container type.

tests.name: with_base_class_t_basic
tests.intent: Verify that basic_json::with_base_class_t applies a custom base class.

tests.name: chaining_aliases_order_one
tests.intent: Verify that multiple with_*_t aliases can be chained sequentially in one order.

tests.name: chaining_aliases_order_two
tests.intent: Verify that chaining aliases in reverse order yields the same correctly configured basic_json type.

tests.name: ordered_json_with_string_t
tests.intent: Verify that using with_*_t aliases on ordered_json preserves ordered_map as the object type.

tests.name: object_t_ordered_equivalence
tests.intent: Verify that json::with_object_t<nlohmann::ordered_map> is identical to ordered_json.

tests.name: deeply_chained_aliases
tests.intent: Verify deep chaining of multiple different alias types on basic_json.

tests.name: with_t_nested_usage
tests.intent: Verify that custom basic_json types produced via aliases can contain and parse nested structures correctly.

tests.name: with_t_type_trait_queries
tests.intent: Verify various standard type traits on a basic_json type created via multiple with_*_t aliases.

tests.name: with_json_serializer_custom_type
tests.intent: Verify using a custom serializer with a type created via with_json_serializer_t.

tests.name: with_base_class_methods
tests.intent: Verify that methods and state of a custom base class are inherited and functional on with_base_class_t types.

tests.name: with_t_cross_conversion
tests.intent: Verify explicit or implicit conversions between standard json and an alias-modified basic_json specialization.

tests.name: gen_21_cpp
tests.intent: Verify instantiation and usage of with_object_t with a custom 3-argument object template container like std::map.

tests.name: gen_22_cpp
tests.intent: Verify instantiation and usage of with_array_t with a custom 2-argument array template container like std::vector.

tests.name: gen_23_cpp
tests.intent: Verify instantiation and usage of with_boolean_t with a custom boolean type representation.

tests.name: gen_24_cpp
tests.intent: Verify instantiation and usage of with_json_serializer_t with a custom serializer template.

tests.name: gen_25_cpp
tests.intent: Verify instantiation and usage of with_base_class_t with a custom base class type.
